comments.note: ThumbnailGeneratorViewModel.cs: The IThumbnailGenerationService interface does not expose an 'OverwriteExisting' parameter; the spec AC referencing it (AC6: 'OverwriteExisting flag is forwarded') cannot be satisfied as written because the interface has no such flag. The service always clears existing thumbnails (DeleteAllByMovieIdAsync) before re-generating, and the confirmation dialog is the ViewModel-layer gate. This is a spec/interface mismatch that should be flagged to QA.

ConfirmRegenerateCommand discards the Task returned by GenerateCommand.ExecuteAsync — this is intentional MVVM fire-and-forget from a synchronous IRelayCommand. The pattern is consistent with other places in the codebase.

comments.note: ThumbnailGeneratorViewModel.cs: clean implementation. [NotifyCanExecuteChangedFor] correctly links IsBusy to GenerateCommand.CanExecute. _regenerationConfirmed reset in the finally block ensures state is clean after each run regardless of outcome.

Ledger AC6 'OverwriteExisting flag is forwarded to IThumbnailGenerationService.GenerateAsync' is stale — IThumbnailGenerationService.GenerateAsync has no OverwriteExisting parameter, and the spec (work/WP-017.md) does not mention OverwriteExisting. The real spec AC6 ('CloseCommand fires CloseRequested') is verified and met. PM should remove this stale ledger criterion.

ConfirmRegenerateCommand uses fire-and-forget (_ = GenerateCommand.ExecuteAsync(null)). The test for AC3 uses Task.Delay(50) to wait for the async operation. This is a timing-based wait that could theoretically be flaky in a heavily loaded CI environment, but the fake service completes synchronously so it is robust in practice.

CancelCommand calls _cts?.Cancel() — works correctly when _cts is null (no-op) but note that _cts is not recreated between runs in the null-safe path. The re-creation pattern (_cts?.Dispose(); _cts = new CancellationTokenSource()) inside Generate() handles this correctly.

summary: Reviewed ThumbnailGeneratorViewModel.cs and ThumbnailGeneratorViewModelTests.cs against all four Review Dimensions.

Maintainability: Well-structured ViewModel with clear visual section separators. _regenerationConfirmed reset in the finally block ensures consistent state after any outcome. Progress reporting closure is readable. Summary builder (parts.Add + string.Join) is clean. Test helpers (FakeThumbnailGenerationService, FakeThumbnailRepository) co-located in test file for proximity.

Best Practices: [RelayCommand(CanExecute=...)] + [NotifyCanExecuteChangedFor] linkage is idiomatic CommunityToolkit. _cts?.Dispose() before new allocation prevents handle accumulation during repeated runs. ConfirmRegenerate fire-and-forget pattern (_ = GenerateCommand.ExecuteAsync) is consistent with codebase and documented.

Performance: Sequential GetCountByMovieIdAsync checks in Generate() are acceptable for the small request counts expected by this UI dialog. Movies.FirstOrDefault scan in Progress callback is O(n) for a small collection — no concern.
All 7 spec ACs verified by QA. Three low-priority observations recorded as improvement comments (not blocking). Stale ledger AC6 flagged as documentation-forward for PM.

comments.note: ThumbnailGeneratorViewModel.Generate() catches OperationCanceledException even though IThumbnailGenerationService.GenerateAsync is documented to 'return normally' on cancellation. This is a valid defensive catch — it guards against implementation drift and protects the UI if a future service implementation accidentally throws. Not a defect; documenting for transparency.

ConfirmRegenerateCommand_SetsRegenerationConfirmedAndGenerates test uses await Task.Delay(50) to synchronise with a fire-and-forget call. With FakeThumbnailGenerationService (awaiting Task.CompletedTask) this is reliable in practice, but is theoretically a timing-dependent assertion. Future maintainers could eliminate the fragility by changing ConfirmRegenerate() to async Task and awaiting GenerateCommand.ExecuteAsync(null), then updating the test to await ConfirmRegenerateCommand.ExecuteAsync(null) directly.

_cts is disposed at the start of each Generate() call (before allocating a new one), but is not disposed when the ViewModel is abandoned after a completed generation run. IDisposable is not currently implemented. The CancellationTokenSource WaitHandle is a minor kernel-object leak for dialog-lifetime ViewModels. Acceptable for current scope; consider adding IDisposable if ViewModel lifecycle management is formalised.
